nodes.title: Deep-Learning-Aided RF Fingerprinting for NFC Security
nodes.dataset: RF signals from 50 NFC tags (same manufacturer/batch) captured via off-the-shelf NFC reader.
nodes.methodology: A hardware testbed with NFC reader and SDR collects RF signals. Three DNNs (FNN, CNN, RNN) analyze one-bit transmission data for RF characteristic extraction.
nodes.contribution: Proposes deep learning for RF fingerprinting in NFC, enabling practical, rapid tag identification with high accuracy.

nodes.title: Cross-Receiver Radio Frequency Fingerprint Identification: A Source-Free Adaptation Approach
nodes.dataset: Real-world datasets (HackRF, Wisig) under realistic noise and channel conditions.
nodes.methodology: Proposes CSCNet, a contrastive learning framework with a three-pronged loss function (entropy minimization, pseudo-label self-supervision, contrastive learning) for unlabeled data adaptation.
nodes.contribution: Defines SCRFFI, introduces pseudo-labeling, proposes CSCNet with contrastive learning, and validates performance on real-world datasets.

nodes.title: A Self-Supervised Contrastive Framework for Specific Emitter Identification with Limited Labeled Data
nodes.dataset: Real-world satellite navigation signals collected using a 40-meter antenna, including Beidou Navigation Satellite System (BDS) data with 10 emitter classes.
nodes.methodology: A two-stage framework combining unsupervised pretraining with contrastive loss and supervised fine-tuning via virtual adversarial training (VAT) to enhance generalization with limited labels.
nodes.contribution: Proposes a novel self-supervised contrastive learning framework, specialized data augmentation strategies, and a hybrid encoder (Transformer + ResNet) for improved RFF extraction.

nodes.dataset: 7 commercial ZigBee devices operating in the 2.4 GHz band (IEEE 802.15.4 standard).
nodes.methodology: A CNN is trained on time-domain complex baseband error signals to detect physical-layer signatures. The method utilizes full transmission data rather than limited signal preambles for classification.
nodes.contribution: Proposed a CNN-based framework for RF fingerprinting using time-domain error signals, demonstrating robustness against spoofing and scalability in cognitive radio networks.

nodes.title: Scribble-Supervised Semantic Segmentation by Uncertainty Reduction on Neural Representation and Self-Supervision on Neural Eigenspace
nodes.dataset: Common scribble datasets (specific names not explicitly mentioned)
nodes.methodology: Proposes uncertainty reduction via entropy minimization and neural random walks, combined with self-supervision on neural eigenspace for consistency.
nodes.contribution: Introduces two solutions: uncertainty reduction on neural representation and self-supervision on neural eigenspace for consistent predictions.
